description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git for-each-repo' builtin, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as configuration handling, error conditions, and command execution across multiple repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific status code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails (non-zero exit status).

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output and asserts its presence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
